title: Canadian Velvety Cheese Soup
description: A comforting and creamy soup perfect for a chilly day. Made with Canadian cheese and velvety texture.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it thickens.
Stir in the Canadian cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the vegetable broth and soup, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5-7 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of Canadian cheese if desired.
